cases.title: Publishing Evidence before its Source stores it without a source reference

steps.why: Close dialogs, toasts and the right sidebar
Open "Share current node" on the page `[[EVD]] - PK 2329 evidence A - [[@PK 2329 source]]`, whose Source isn't published yet

cases.proves: the starting state of the Evidence-then-Source order: Evidence A is stored without its source reference
cases.checks: Evidence A is in the database with no source reference.
cases.caption: Evidence A names a Source that isn't in the database yet. Publishing it stores the node, with no source reference.

expect.js: (async () => { const row = (await proof.waitFor(async () => (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id,reference_content,source_local_id&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.pk2329eva', { key: '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}' }))[0], { what: 'the published Evidence A concept', timeout: 15000, interval: 500 })); proof.assert(!(row.reference_content || {}).sourceDocument, 'Evidence A already has a source reference: ' + JSON.stringify(row.reference_content)); })()

cases.title: Publishing the Source afterwards gives Evidence A its source reference

steps.why: Close dialogs, toasts and the right sidebar
Open "Share current node" on the page `@PK 2329 source`

cases.proves: Done When 1: Publishing Evidence, then its Source, stores the Evidence's source reference, so importing that Evidence can import the Source and resolve its title without the missing-source warning.
cases.checks: Evidence A's source reference points to `@PK 2329 source`.
cases.caption: Now the Source is published. Evidence A, which is not published again, gets its reference to the Source.

expect.js: (async () => { const src = (await proof.waitFor(async () => (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id,reference_content,source_local_id&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.pk2329src', { key: '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}' }))[0], { what: 'the published Source concept', timeout: 15000, interval: 500 })); await proof.waitFor(async () => { const row = (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/Concept?select=id,reference_content,source_local_id&is_schema=eq.false&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=eq.pk2329eva', { key: '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}' }))[0]; return row && (row.reference_content || {}).sourceDocument === src.id; }, { what: 'Evidence A to reference the Source concept ' + src.id, timeout: 15000, interval: 500 }); })()

cases.title: Publishing the Source doesn't publish Evidence B or Evidence C
cases.proves: Done When 2: Publishing a Source does not publish or grant access to any other node.
cases.checks: Evidence B and Evidence C aren't in the database and have no group access. Only the Source and Evidence A are published.
cases.caption: Evidence B also names the Source, but it was never published. Publishing the Source left it alone.

expect.js: (async () => { const key = '{{env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}'; const list = '(pk2329src,pk2329eva,pk2329evb,pk2329evc,pk2329orp)'; const rows = async (table) => (await proof.rest('/rest/v1/' + table + '?select=source_local_id&space_id=eq.120237&source_local_id=in.' + list, { key })).map((row) => row.source_local_id).sort(); for (const table of ['Concept', 'Content', 'ResourceAccess']) { const ids = await rows(table); proof.assert(!ids.includes('pk2329evb') && !ids.includes('pk2329evc'), table + ' has a row for an unpublished node: ' + JSON.stringify(ids)); } const access = await rows('ResourceAccess'); proof.assert(access.includes('pk2329src') && access.includes('pk2329eva'), 'The Source and Evidence A should be the published nodes: ' + JSON.stringify(access)); })()

surface.area: Publish nodes to a group (Export dialog)
surface.why: restoreSourceReferences now runs inside every publishNodesToGroups call after the concept upsert, and a thrown error is caught and sent to internalError so it must not block the publish.

surface.area: Source reference on other Evidence/dependent nodes
surface.why: The new update matches any page whose title contains the Source's title, so Evidence naming the Source is found by a substring scan, and nodes that merely mention the title could be caught.

surface.area: Evidence already linked to a Source
surface.why: The update is filtered on reference_content->>sourceDocument being null, so it must not overwrite a reference that already exists.
The change deliberately avoids re-upserting the Evidence, so its stored title/body and edit time must stay as they were while only the reference changes.

surface.area: Sources with unusual or imported identity
surface.why: Dependents are matched via sourceIdOfNode, which returns an RID for imported Sources while the restore keys by the local Source uid.
The title scan is meant to run only when a Source node is among those published, so ordinary publishes should be unaffected.

surface.area: Source node type naming and settings
surface.why: The Source type is found by sourceSlotSchemaId, which looks for a node type named 'source' or falls back to the default id, and Evidence is found by a {source} placeholder in its format.
